title: I keep going to an enormous elaborate hotel each night
content: It must be 200 stories high, just taller than anything I can think of, and I’m always exploring weird stair wells and hidden spaces within the hotel. The room itself is very elaborate with ornate detailing on the walls, staircases and big golden banisters, multiple bedrooms, etc. I go back to some variation of this most nights. Anyone else have something similar?
